mapper.insert: insert into pokemon(pokemon_no, pokemon_name, pokemon_type, pokemon_like) values (#{pokemonNo}, #{pokemonName}, #{pokemonType}, 0)
mapper.select: select * from pokemon order by pokemon_no asc
mapper.update:
update pokemon
pokemon_name=#{pokemonName},
pokemon_type=#{pokemonType},
pokemon_like=#{pokemonLike},
where pokemon_no=#{pokemonNo}
